projects.title: Small-Image Classification Course Project
bullets: Trained a compact image classifier using Python, PyTorch and NumPy as part of a supervised undergraduate course project with another student.
Summarized classification errors for public small-object image collections in the course project's study of classification under input changes.

research.title: Small-Image Classification Research Assistance
bullets: Trained a compact image classifier using Python, PyTorch and NumPy as a student research assistant contributing to supervised faculty research.
Summarized classification errors for public handwritten-symbol image collections within a supervised study of small-image classification under input changes.
